method: Two alternating before/after runs from frozen v43 baseline and final v44 source after UI snapshot prewarming freeze. Eight groups x 400 rows per client; 64 MiB SQLite padding; WeChat additionally 64 MiB voice database. Same probe, fixtures and interpreter as prior measurement. Warm/cached local filesystem; wall seconds include open, parse, batch approval, publication, resume and metadata repair. Hash bytes count successful explicit Python SHA-256 reads, not OS physical reads or SQLite internal reads. Integrity check timers are inclusive and must not be summed with hash timers.

limitations: No real account, live process, encrypted input, network drive or physical power loss was exercised.
Samples contain ordinary text and no quotes; unrelated concurrent v44 quote/lazy-view changes are not exercised.
Two samples show local timing only; deterministic hash-byte savings are the stronger scaling evidence.
Unoptimized single-group parse keeps both integrity boundaries; no cross-operation stat-only cache.

review.result: No additional integrity-scope defect found; downstream UI receipt status issue handed to UI agent by root.

phaseAccounting: Final group source loading prewarms snapshot inventory before it becomes available for selection. The first-parse checkpoint reuses that inventory. Its full snapshot hash read moved from parseAll into openSource; per-group parse boundary checks remain unchanged. Batch publication and metadata repair still use 2 full snapshot validation rounds instead of 9.
